contents.content: Victoria will make changes as she see fits: that means she is making changes that she thinks are necessary.

Victoria will have to look at what needs to take precedence. To "take precedence" means to add to.
Victoria would like to tack a couple more things on to the proposal: that means she will consider what important things need to stay in the proposal.
Victoria will alter a few things in the proposal. She will ​slightly change a few things.

_data.content: Dealing with stress, which affects many people, is not easy .
